evidence.quote: Provider shall maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001

items.question: Whose consent does the tenant need to assign the whole warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The tenant needs the Landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease.

Clause 7.1 states that the Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld [1].

evidence.quote: The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
